title: Cursor Now Deploys Live Applications Built by AI Agents
summary:
The AI code editor has launched a capability that allows users to generate and host live applications directly through its interface using natural language descriptions. The new tool uses agents to write the code, configure databases, and conduct security checks before deploying the finished application to a shareable link.

The update aims to reduce the number of AI-generated projects that remain in local development environments. The feature integrates with Vercel to enable applications built with Cursor and the Grok AI model to be hosted and scaled on the web.
